$comment: Sign-in settings for the preview project, applied by supabase/scripts/auth-config.sh. ${NAME} is read from the environment when the script runs: YUNTERA_SHOP_URL and YUNTERA_REDIRECT_URLS (comma-separated <app address>/auth/confirm for each app). Confirmation stays off on the preview until custom SMTP exists: the built-in sender only mails members of the Supabase organisation, twice an hour.
